# ClearBank Developer Portal

> ClearBank Developer Portal - our API documentation. This site renders API documentation from a public GitHub repository and collapses API schemas, request/response examples and webhook payloads behind interactive dropdowns that are often missing from the rendered HTML. The links below point to the raw source files (branch `main`), which contain the complete, machine-readable content. Prefer these over scraping the rendered pages.

## API endpoint schemas (OpenAPI JSON)
Pages reference each schema by its OpenAPI `info.version`, shown below.
- `1.0.SterlingAutomatedTransfer` — [data/endpoints/automated-cash-isa-transfer-v1.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/clearbank/clearbank.github.io/main/data/endpoints/automated-cash-isa-transfer-v1.json)
